description: A date range picker built on top of `v-date-picker`. Shows two adjacent months side-by-side or a single column of vertically scrolling months with a shared range selection.

props.independentMonths: Decouples the two calendar panels so each month can be navigated independently. Applies only when **scrollable** is disabled.
props.scrollable: Shows months in a single vertically scrolling column. Month and year labels scroll with their calendars while the weekday row stays visible. Use **min** and **max** to limit the available dates.

events.update:modelValue: Emitted when the range selection changes.

slots.footer: Slot rendered below the calendar panels. Sits inside the picker container so it does not span across externally composed siblings such as a presets sidebar.
